answer: One concrete sybil defense in an AI-agent economy requires every identity to continuously cultivate a unique computational orchard of verified interactions. Each agent must periodically prove ownership of scarce jade tokens locked as collateral; simultaneous fakes force the attacker to replicate the full stake and proof workload across every identity. Deploying such replicas on remote tundra nodes multiplies energy and capital costs linearly with the number of sybils, making large-scale identity forgery economically unviable compared with honest participation.
